title.en: Explain why controlling is both backward and forward looking

say.en: A Google Maps route tells you where to go, but you still glance at it to see whether you have drifted. Controlling is that glance for a business. In this lesson: Define controlling.
Explain its features.
Explain why controlling is both backward and forward looking.

body.en: *Controlling* means ensuring that activities in an organisation are performed as per the plans. It compares actual performance with planned standards, finds deviations and takes corrective action. It is the last function of management but leads back to planning.
body.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳು ಯೋಜನೆಯಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿವೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸುವುದು. ವಾಸ್ತವ ಸಾಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾನದಂಡದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದು.

title.en: On the board: Controlling closes the loop

narration.en: Controlling makes sure that work goes according to plan.

say.en: Controlling makes sure that work goes according to plan.
It compares actual performance with the plan, finds the gap and corrects it.
The lessons go back into the next plan, so controlling is both the last function and a new start.
Features: goal-oriented, pervasive, continuous, and both backward and forward looking.
Backward looking: it checks what has already happened. Forward looking: it improves what comes next.
Controlling makes sure that work goes according to plan.

explanation.en: Controlling ensures that work goes as planned: it compares actual with standard, finds deviations and corrects them, and its lessons feed the next plan.

passage.en: Controlling compares __1__ performance with planned __2__, finds the __3__ and takes __4__ action. It is the __5__ function of management, but it leads back to __6__. It looks back because it checks work already done, and it looks ahead because it improves __7__ performance.

say.en: Complete the paragraph about controlling.

body.en: Controlling is backward looking because it checks performance that has already taken place. It is also *forward looking* because it uses this experience to improve future performance and future plans.
body.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಾಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಹಿಂದುಮುಖಿ; ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಸಾಧನೆ ಸುಧಾರಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಮುಂದುಮುಖಿಯೂ ಹೌದು.

problem.en: A school principal finds that only 70% of the syllabus was covered by December against a plan of 85%. She arranges extra classes in January and plans an earlier start next year. Which features of controlling are seen?

steps.en: Comparing 70% with the planned 85% looks at past performance: backward looking.
Extra classes and an earlier start next year improve future performance: forward looking.
It is done in a school, a non-business organisation: controlling is pervasive.

answer.en: Controlling is backward looking, forward looking and pervasive.
